properties.evidence: The check it runs (deprecation::changelog_problems) binds an entry's announcement to deprecated_in's section and counts deprecated_in equal to the crate version as uncut, so #799's entries (deprecated_in 0.91.0, announced in the 0.92.0 fragment) passed until the version moved to 0.92.0 and fail now; measured both ways (#802 CI green at 0.91.0, both feature sets red at 0.92.0).
